items.title: Desktop/Shelf Puzzle Calendar
items.description: Students craft a 12-sided dodecahedron calendar to learn Platonic solid geometry. Rotating its physical faces builds spatial reasoning while encouraging screen-free, mindful time management thinking.

items.title: Moonlit Wolf Layered Laser Cutting Wall Art
items.description: Students design multi-layer silhouettes via precise laser cutting. They explore light-shadow layering, refine artistic aesthetics and strengthen delicate hands-on crafting abilities in visual art creation.

items.title: Windmill metronome
items.description: Using our P Series Models, students assemble swingable windmill blades and rhythm-sync light strips. The project combines mechanical structures, circuit wiring and beat logic for comprehensive engineering training.

items.title: Terrain Model
items.description: In this project, students will construct laser-cut 3D topographical models to explore physical geography. This engaging activity enhances spatial awareness, making it suitable for Geography or Earth Science courses.

items.title: DIY Name Tag
items.description: In this project, students will design and personalize metal name tags mounted on wooden boards. This hands-on activity fosters creativity and craftsmanship, making it perfect for Arts and Crafts classes.
